attack: Strongest opposing claim is trend-follower's: the delivered Fed hike, SOFR 3.85, hot US gauges and a still-hiking SR3 strip mean AUD stays bid and NZD stays the funding currency, so AUDNZD continuation is the trend and a put is a premature fade. FACT: their expression is pay SR3 Mar-27 at 4.565, not long AUDNZD. INFERENCE: US hike continuation can coexist with an AUDNZD distribution if housing caps the RBA while NZDUSD is already the stretched leg. A 99th-percentile yield is what a hiking trend looks like; a 99.96th-percentile cross at 5 percent realized vol is a different object. Their own principal-risks line on AU housing is the concession that the AUD_UP tag is not entailed by the SOFR trade. I concede the US path is still hiking; I do not concede that this prices AUDNZD one-way.

Cross-merchant is the spot expression this remit exists to reject. FACT: AUDCAD 20-day RV 4.38, 5y percentile 99.96, 1m move almost entirely USDCAD +1.74 percent not AUDUSD. INFERENCE: they are short a grind manufactured by USD-leg multiplication, with residual RBA hike risk still in AONIA October 4.565. A linear short into a retested high is the structure that loses if timing slips; a 3M put on the hotter Oceania cross owns both the housing tail and the squeeze tail. Their reason for skipping AUDNZD (NZ path missing) is exactly why options dominate spot on that pair.

expression_comparison.rationale: FACT: the discrepancy is a compressed-realized, two-sided event distribution around a 5-year AUDNZD extreme, not a one-way spot path. Short AUDNZD spot is the obvious alternative and is inferior: AONIA still prices about +21.5bp by October and about +59.5bp by August 2027, so a linear short can be run over if residual RBA tightening keeps the cross bid; NZ yields and AUDNZD 2Y carry are unavailable, so the spot short's carry cost is unquantified; housing prints, NZ data, energy headlines and global hike follow-through can reprice either tail. Long 3M 25-delta AUD puts (or a 25d risk-reversal only if live RR does not already own the downside) bounds that timing risk. AONIA outright or AU-US 2Y RV would own the RBA-housing rates gap but would not own the NZD-collapse tail that created the cross extreme. USDJPY vol after the +1.41 percent BoJ day is the wrong event: that realized has already printed at 20-day RV 11.04. Cross-merchant short AUDCAD is the same linearization on a quieter 4.38 RV product.

context_build.causal_mechanism: The market is treating AUDNZD as a one-way RBA-over-RBNZ regime: residual AONIA hike pricing plus a still-hot AU inflation gauge keep AUD bid, while NZDUSD is used as the soft-growth/funding currency even after a Q2 GDP beat and an India FTA. The tested mechanism is that this priced regime is internally inconsistent. Australia's tightening channel is already visible in housing (NSW stamp duty -24 percent y/y, transactions -18 percent, Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7 percent below peak) while AONIA still prices more hikes; New Zealand's real-side gauges are weak (labor 32, consumer 38, activity 47) with inflation still 80, but the official NZ curve is missing so the market cannot be shown a coherent NZ path. The next move is a distribution: delayed mean-reversion if housing caps the RBA, or a squeeze/continuation if hike pricing stays dominant. Options own that distribution; spot does not.

revised_trade.thesis: FACT: AUDNZD is at a 5-year extreme because NZDUSD collapsed, not because AUDUSD broke out. AU housing is showing the tightening channel while AONIA still prices about +21.5bp by October and about +59.5bp by August 2027. NZ Q2 GDP 0.2 percent q/q beat and an India FTA have not reversed NZD. NZ yields are missing. Fed hike to 3.75-4.00 percent and BoJ hike to 1.25 percent are delivered. USDJPY 20-day RV is 11.04 versus AUDNZD 5.09. VIX crushed to 15.44 on 17 Sep (14.7th percentile). No FX option marks exist. CFTC 15 Sep does not show a crowded leveraged-fund AUD long. Official SOFR is 3.85 ACT/360. Sidecar open_positions is empty. INFERENCE: the market is pricing a one-way RBA-over-RBNZ regime that is internally inconsistent with housing and with NZ data, so the next move is a distribution with a delayed mean-reversion tail and a squeeze tail. Spot is dominated because timing is uncertain and event risk is two-sided after realized FX vol on this cross stayed near 5 percent. Opposing AUD_UP/NZD_DOWN tags are unexpressed on SOFR or USDCAD and do not mark the put. UNKNOWN: 3M ATMF IV, 25-delta risk-reversal, quoted premium, strike grid, and the RBNZ curve. All must be checked before any OPEN. The paper book therefore HOLDs; the debate trade is still the put.
revised_trade.mispricing: Priced: residual RBA hikes and a permanently weak NZD can be owned linearly in AUDNZD at ~5 percent realized vol. Disagreed: housing versus still-priced AONIA hikes plus a missing NZ curve makes the next 1-3 months a two-tailed event distribution. The edge, if any, is in cheap downside optionality versus that distribution, not in a spot short of AUDCAD or a tagged NZD-down on USDCAD. Implied vol is UNKNOWN, so this is a debate mispricing until IV/RR are marked.
